For an East/West split (90° and 270° azimuth) at 20° tilt in Phoenix, the mismatch loss when moving from dual MPPT to a single shared MPPT is typically between 1% and 5% depending on the specific module/inverter defaults loaded. The system capacity for 24 modules (12 per string x 2 strings) should be approximately 7-9 kW DC depending on the default module used.
